job.title: (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Consultant & Project Manager role needs someone who links client needs and technical delivery – my daily work for 5+ years on e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Requirements, user stories and functional specifications with stakeholders
– Agile delivery with PI Planning, Jira, Confluence and UAT
– Hands-on technical depth in APIs and PIM / ERP integration

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Consultant & Project Manager E-Commerce | Techno-Functional | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce consultant with 5+ years on enterprise B2B and B2C commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Translates client requirements into solutions: requirements engineering, user stories, functional specifications, process mapping, stakeholder management and UAT, backed by hands-on technical depth in APIs and PIM / ERP / MDM integration. Works in agile teams with Jira, Confluence and PI Planning, coordinates with international teams and uses AI tools extensively in analysis and documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: foobar builds digital products for brands, where good consulting depends on understanding both the business and the technology. I want to apply my techno-functional e-commerce experience in an agency setting with varied clients, close collaboration and direct ownership of project success. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.

en.subject: Application: (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager
en.hook: A consultant and project manager at a digital agency has to understand what clients really need and make sure the technical team delivers it. That combination is my strength: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have worked on large e-commerce platforms between business stakeholders and development teams, with deep hands-on technical experience behind every recommendation.

bullets.label: Client requirements & consulting
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Project coordination
bullets.text: Gathered business requirements with product owners, mapped processes, supported UAT and worked in agile delivery with PI Planning, Jira and Confluence.

bullets.label: Technical credibility
bullets.text: Resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international technical teams and engineered API migrations for customer account structures.

bullets.label: Delivery & go-live
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and supported production issues after go-live.
